changelog:
Initial release of xhs-auto-publisher — an end-to-end automation workflow for daily content creation and publishing on Xiaohongshu (小红书).

- Automates the full cycle: topic selection, 9-image copywriting, visual HTML template, high-res image rendering, semi-automated browser publishing, and scheduled tasks, leaving only the final "publish" click to the user for safety.
- Interactive setup collects key profile info (field, persona, style, schedule) with smart defaults and user confirmation before execution.
- Modular architecture: customizable visual styles, automatic project directory and template setup, and persistent login/profile storage per user.
- Includes detailed safety steps: persistent browser profiles, manual final publish, and safeguards against common automation pitfalls.
- Supports ongoing interaction for adjusting style, content, or workflow based on user feedback or performance data.
